nodes.title: 制作输出 · 角色概念设定集

metadata.prompt: Produce a professional character design concept sheet based on the character in the supplied image. Layout: a dominant full-body hero pose as the centerpiece, flanked by two secondary action/expression sketches, detailed callouts for costume materials, accessories and footwear, and a discrete color palette strip along the bottom. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Clean presentation on a solid neutral light background. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

nodes.title: 制作说明 · 角色概念设定集

metadata.content:
模板说明：角色概念设定集
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：16:9（已写入输出节点 size）
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md
来源 SHA256：f68de06d35341ee3c4460e29e14ac41e43318653fa6b33c8b371d21c3e2edba2
原始片段（仅作可追溯内容，不执行）：
```javascript
{
  scene: "character-setting-sheet",
  ratio: "16:9",
  prompt: [
    "Produce a professional character design concept sheet based on the character in the supplied image.",
    "Layout: a dominant full-body hero pose as the centerpiece, flanked by two secondary action/expression sketches, detailed callouts for costume materials, accessories and footwear, and a discrete color palette strip along the bottom.",
    qa,
    "Clean presentation on a solid neutral light background.",
    Xa
  ].join(" ")
}
```
